classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins bearing ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0051747) and NAD(P)HX epimerase (GO:0097163) molecular-function annotations, then rank candidates by compositional and biochemical quality using available VPA tools.
assumptions: GO:0051747 is used as the molecular-function term for ADP-dependent (S)-NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity; the paired literature_search node validates this functional context and surfaces any preferred sister terms.
GO:0097163 is used as the molecular-function term for NAD(P)HX epimerase activity; the paired literature_search node validates this context.
Only reviewed (Swiss-Prot) UniProt entries are retrieved and IEA evidence is excluded to maximise annotation reliability.
sequence_analysis fasta_path input receives the multi-sequence FASTA file produced by each go_sequences node; the tool handles multi-record FASTA natively.

ESM3 per-sequence embedding is deferred to a post-ranking step because extracting individual sequence strings from a multi-record FASTA is not a single-step VPA operation; rank_designs uses sequence_analysis composition, charge, and motif records instead.
rank_designs top_k=20 yields a tractable representative set for downstream review or submission decisions.
pH 7.4 is used for charge calculations as a physiologically representative condition for cytosolic NAD(P)HX repair enzymes.

success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_dehydratase returns at least 1 reviewed FASTA sequence for GO:0051747
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_epimerase returns at least 1 reviewed FASTA sequence for GO:0097163
success_criteria.analyses_complete: analysis_dehydratase and analysis_epimerase both produce composition, region, and motif annotation records
success_criteria.ranking_produced: ranking node returns a scored ordered list of up to 20 representative NAD(P)HX repair candidates with per-sequence biochemical metrics

inputs.query: ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase NADHX repair enzyme GO molecular function
NADPHX epimerase NAD(P)H-hydrate epimerase NAXE metabolite repair
